walk:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite sheet extension for an existing top-down fantasy RPG. Reference images: first is the existing hero WALK sheet, second is matching sword ATTACK sheet. Preserve this EXACT small young male hero identity, same hair silhouette, warm chestnut hair, cream scarf, long indigo/navy coat with gold piping, burgundy/red waistcoat with gold clasps, gray/taupe trousers, brown boots, leather satchel, same proportions and material detail, amber upper-left light, dark plum outlines. Do not redesign or increase pixel detail scale.

Create ONLY four DIAGONAL walking direction rows, exactly SIX frames per row (24 separate full-body sprites in a regular 6 column by 4 row grid). Output transparent background, no shadows, no text or grid lines. Give generous empty space per cell, equal cell sizes, identical body scale/ground line, full sprites unclipped. Row 1 down-right (southeast): three-quarter FRONT, face clearly toward lower-right, both eyes visible with far eye foreshortened. Row 2 down-left (southwest): three-quarter FRONT toward lower-left. Row 3 up-right (northeast): three-quarter BACK facing upper-right, right cheek barely visible, satchel and back of coat visible. Row 4 up-left (northwest): three-quarter BACK toward upper-left. These must truly be diagonal views, not the cardinal front/side/back views in the reference, and no tilting the body on the canvas. Torso stays upright.

Each row is one seamless six-frame WALK cycle: 0 neutral/feet together (also useful idle base), 1 left contact, 2 passing, 3 right contact, 4 passing, 5 recover toward neutral. Actual alternating legs and opposite arm swing, subtle coat tails and scarf follow through, no repeated identical poses. Preserve the hero's identity between every frame. Body/head height and foot baseline identical across rows. Match the reference's detailed crisp pixel fantasy style, NOT vector, not smooth painting, no new costume or weapon for walking. Do not include other directions or any attack frames. Render sprite characters at about 180 px tall within a 1536x1024 sheet, with clear separation between every sprite.

attack:

Reference 1 is the approved diagonal walk identity, reference 2 is current cardinal attack timing/weapon, reference 3 current cardinal walk. Preserve EXACT same chestnut hair, cream scarf, indigo long coat/gold piping, burgundy waistcoat, gray trousers, brown boots, leather satchel, chibi proportions and upper-left warm light. Crisp detailed pixel-art at the same detail scale.

Transparent background. A REGULAR grid of exactly EIGHT columns and FOUR rows, 32 separate complete unclipped full-body sprites, roomy equal cells, same body height and ground line. Row 1 down-right (southeast, three-quarter FRONT toward right); row 2 down-left (southwest, three-quarter FRONT toward left); row 3 up-right (northeast, three-quarter REAR toward right, back of head/coat dominant, tiny right cheek only); row 4 up-left (northwest, three-quarter REAR toward left, back dominant).
